notes: Series and movies get matched without a TMDB key: first by the IDs Plex and .nfo files next to your videos already know (read only), then on TVmaze (series: title, year, description, genres, poster, episode titles) and Wikidata (films: title, year, short description). A name only counts when the title is the same and the folder's year fits; anything unclear stays 'Not matched' for Wrong match? on the show page. With a TMDB key, TMDB uses those IDs instead of a name search, and films whose year is more than one off no longer match. Settings > Series and movie matching can switch the lookups off.
